name: comp-170

frames.best_why: Yearly is chosen with its green discount and raised block at rest, and no cursor covers the control.

tagline: Two billing periods on a block that slides and dims the idle side.
summary: A two-part switch for monthly or yearly billing that slides a raised block under the chosen half. The yearly side shows a green -20% note while it is active, and the other label fades to grey.
appearance: A rounded dark track holds two labels side by side: Bill Monthly, then Bill Yearly with a small -20% beside it. The chosen half sits on a lighter raised block with bold white text, while the idle label fades back.
behaviour: Clicking either half slides the lighter block across in about a third of a second and dims the label it leaves. The recording opens on yearly, moves to monthly, then returns to yearly.
search_phrases: switch between monthly and yearly billing
use_when: On a pricing page or checkout, when a buyer should compare a monthly and a yearly charge.
avoid_when: Only two fixed labels with one hardcoded discount; a third cycle or per-plan prices need edits in the file.
customise: Both labels, the -20% note and the starting choice are written in the file; change them there. Slide time, easing curve and the green accent are classes in the same file.
weight_why: Two labels over a single pseudo-element that slides; idle once a choice is made.

a11y.note: Both halves are real radios reached with arrow keys, and the moving block shows a focus ring; the 300ms slide ignores reduced-motion settings.

issues: Mid-slide both labels look dim, so the choice reads as undecided for a moment.
polish_why: Crisp two-state control with a smooth slide; the mid-slide frame looks undecided.
title: Billing Period Toggle
